verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document fleet-scale concurrency or any limits on concurrent sandbox instances. The closest item (docs-17) covers multiplexing many SDK operations over one connection to avoid subrequest limits. That is about concurrent calls to a sandbox, not running large fleets of sandboxes or published per-account concurrency caps, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits
